# Use a dependency-only task to retain Mac symbol-upload prerequisites

The upload-symbols dummy kind depends on build and upload-symbols and uses from_deps, per_platform_dummy and mac_dummy transforms. Its macosx64-shippable task groups dependencies with unique-kinds=false and uses a succeed worker. The description states that it pulls both Mac x64 and aarch64 symbol tasks. This is task graph integration, not a real symbol uploader implemented by the dummy worker. Preserve the dependency and platform scope when changing it. Upstream transforms and an actual generated graph were not executed.

Scope: taskcluster/mac-symbol-dependencies.
